framework.name: Trustworthy AI Readiness Starter
framework.notes: Original starter questions organised around the seven ALTAI requirements and cross-referenced to selected EU AI Act provisions. This is not an official ALTAI implementation or a legal compliance checklist.

regulatory_references.title: EU AI Act Article 9 - Risk management system
EU AI Act Article 10 - Data and data governance
EU AI Act Article 11 - Technical documentation
EU AI Act Article 13 - Transparency and information to deployers
EU AI Act Article 14 - Human oversight
EU AI Act Article 15 - Accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity
EU AI Act Article 17 - Quality management system
EU AI Act Article 72 - Post-market monitoring

requirements.title: Human agency and oversight
requirements.description: Define meaningful human authority, competence and intervention points.

questions.text: Are the decisions supported or made by the AI system assigned to people with clear authority and accountability?
questions.guidance: Name the responsible role, decision boundary and escalation path.

questions.text: Can authorised people understand, challenge, override or stop the system when its use creates unacceptable risk?
questions.guidance: Define intervention controls and test them in realistic scenarios.

questions.text: Do operators receive role-specific instructions and training on capabilities, limitations and foreseeable misuse?
questions.guidance: Maintain training material, completion records and refresher triggers.

requirements.title: Technical robustness and safety
requirements.description: Test performance, failure handling and security throughout the lifecycle.

questions.text: Are performance thresholds, failure modes and acceptable residual risks documented for the intended context?
questions.guidance: Record measurable thresholds, assumptions and owners for residual-risk acceptance.

questions.text: Is the system tested before release and after material changes using representative normal, edge and failure scenarios?
questions.guidance: Link test cases and results to requirements and release decisions.

questions.text: Are AI-specific and conventional cybersecurity threats assessed, monitored and handled?
questions.guidance: Document threat scenarios, controls, monitoring and response procedures.

requirements.title: Privacy and data governance
requirements.description: Control data provenance, suitability, access and known limitations.

questions.text: Can the team trace the origin, preparation, permitted use and quality checks for relevant datasets?
questions.guidance: Maintain dataset records covering source, transformations, quality checks and usage conditions.

questions.text: Are access, retention and protection controls defined for personal or otherwise sensitive data?
questions.guidance: Link data classifications to access rules, retention decisions and security controls.

questions.text: Are data gaps, errors and bias risks documented with mitigation or monitoring actions?
questions.guidance: Record affected groups or contexts, detection methods, mitigations and unresolved limitations.

requirements.title: Transparency
requirements.description: Provide traceable records and information suited to affected stakeholders.

questions.text: Are intended users told the system's purpose, capabilities, limitations and required interpretation of outputs?
questions.guidance: Prepare concise instructions for the actual user roles and deployment context.

questions.text: Can significant system outputs be traced to the relevant version, input, configuration and human decision?
questions.guidance: Define identifiers and records that support reconstruction of significant decisions.

questions.text: Are logging scope, access and retention proportionate to the risks and review needs?
questions.guidance: Document what is logged, why, for how long and who can review it.

requirements.title: Diversity, non-discrimination and fairness
requirements.description: Evaluate accessibility and uneven outcomes across relevant people and contexts.

questions.text: Have relevant affected groups, usage contexts and barriers to access been identified with stakeholder input?
questions.guidance: Document who may be affected and how their needs informed requirements or review.

questions.text: Is performance evaluated across relevant groups or contexts using defined fairness and error measures?
questions.guidance: Select measures appropriate to the use case and retain disaggregated results where lawful.

questions.text: Are identified disparities assigned mitigation, acceptance or monitoring decisions with accountable owners?
questions.guidance: Record the decision, rationale, owner and review date for each material disparity.

requirements.title: Societal and environmental well-being
requirements.description: Consider environmental resources, societal effects and foreseeable misuse.

questions.text: Are material compute, energy or resource impacts measured or estimated across development and operation?
questions.guidance: Record the measurement boundary, method, result and reduction options.

questions.text: Have broader effects on people, work practices and essential processes been reviewed before deployment?
questions.guidance: Document affected processes, stakeholder input, trade-offs and safeguards.

questions.text: Are foreseeable misuse and unintended-use scenarios included in risk review and user guidance?
questions.guidance: Maintain scenarios, controls, detection signals and response actions.

requirements.title: Accountability
requirements.description: Assign ownership and maintain reviewable evidence over the system lifecycle.

questions.text: Are governance responsibilities, approvals and change controls defined across the AI system lifecycle?
questions.guidance: Map accountable and responsible roles to lifecycle decisions and records.

questions.text: Does technical documentation connect requirements, design choices, data, tests, limitations and releases?
questions.guidance: Use stable identifiers so reviewers can trace claims to maintained evidence.

questions.text: Are deployed-system monitoring, incident handling and periodic reassessment triggers defined?
questions.guidance: Specify indicators, thresholds, review cadence, incident routes and reassessment events.
